scripts.clean: shx rm -rf dist && npm run clean --workspaces
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "ai,agent,coding-agent,tui" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,red,magenta" "cd packages/ai && npm run dev" "cd packages/agent && npm run dev" "cd packages/coding-agent && npm run dev" "cd packages/tui && npm run dev"
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:shrinkwrap && npm run check:install-lock:coding-agent && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-browser-smoke.mjs
scripts.generate:models: npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-models && npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-image-models
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.publish: npm run prepublishOnly && node scripts/prepare-senpi-bundled-workspaces.mjs && npm publish -ws --access public --tag latest --provenance
scripts.publish:dry: npm run prepublishOnly && node scripts/prepare-senpi-bundled-workspaces.mjs && npm publish -ws --access public --tag latest --provenance --dry-run
